# anarchydev.games

> One-man indie game studio run by Piotr Kosmala (demoscene handle: Insert). It makes and publishes new original games for Atari XL/XE (Atari 8-bit) computers, released as boxed cartridge editions. The first game, Wittich, is an arcade action game coming in 2027.

## Wittich (2027)

- [Wittich – game page](https://anarchydev.games/wittich/): new arcade action game for Atari XL/XE.
- Platform: Atari XL/XE, Atari 8-bit; runs on any stock Atari XL/XE with 64 KB.
- Edition: exclusive cartridge edition in a box (physical release). Release: 2027.
- Story: 1400 A.D. Darkness rises beneath fallen ruins. The Demon King reclaims his throne and graves lie empty. Brother Gunter Wittich descends below to end the nightmare.
- Gameplay: dash attacks, demons, keys, power crystals, hordes of monsters and deadly traps, giant bosses; 3 cursed lands and 200+ rooms.
- Credits: code and pixel art by Piotr Kosmala (Insert); original soundtrack by Piotr Świerszcz (Tatqoo / Taquart / NG / Moonshine). Pixel art by a real artist, not AI.
- Release news are announced first on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/AnarchyDevGames/

## Studio and author

- [anarchydev.games – home](https://anarchydev.games/): games, demoscene pixel art gallery, about, contact.
- Piotr Kosmala (Insert): game developer, pixel artist and demoscene artist. First commercial game on the Amiga in 1996; worked on titles including SUPERHOT and Liberated, on 8-bit computers, Amiga, PC, Xbox, PlayStation and Nintendo Switch. Active on the Atari demoscene since the 1990s.
- Demoscene pixel art: Atari XL/XE, C64 and Amiga graphics competitions 1997–2026 (e.g. 1st place at Silly Venture SE 2026, Silly Venture 2010 and Intel Outside 1997).
- MobyGames: https://www.mobygames.com/person/250112/piotr-kosmala/
- Demozoo: https://demozoo.org/sceners/5551/
